correctness.rationale: The derivative equations yield precisely seven points P_t indexed by \(t^7=1\). Their Hessian quadratic form has nonzero mixed term and, after scaling, factors over F4 but not F2. The local completed singularity is A3; its 2-step resolution has a central rational P1 and two Galois-conjugate outer components over odd-degree residue fields. Thus the exceptional point corrections and the radicial P2 projection yield all-n point counts and a formal exact zeta product. A standalone finite-field checker corroborates all cases n=1,...,6 and local tangent splitting; no finite sample is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The Hasse–Weil zeta function is a natural exact invariant of this canonical F2 K3 model; the 7 A3 singularity basket alone does not determine its arithmetic. A complete Frobenius cycle census on the 21 exceptional curves explains the local descent and yields every extension point count. This is meaningful new arithmetic information about the symmetric Klein quartic construction, though not a full moduli or automorphism classification.
